answers: issue-acceptance finding 1: wrong — the test is wrong: tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: The S5 sub-test (tagged [#1805/DSFSTG-1]) runs `--from-stage cyc` without `--resume` on `status=in_progress` and asserts SUCCESS. The same acceptance file contains DSFSTG-4 tests (S11, S12) that require `--from-stage` without `--resume` on `status=interrupted` to FAIL. Satisfying both requires the narrowed guard (fires only for `interrupted`). Broadening the guard to catch `in_progress` too (which would satisfy RQFROM-4 in full) breaks S5.
